calibration_sources: Microsoft DiskANN / Vamana (Sub-5ms Billion-Scale ANNS on a Single Node with NVMe SSDs)
NVIDIA cuVS CAGRA (GPU-Native Graph Index Construction & Warp-Split Search Benchmarks)
RaBitQ (Quantizing High-Dimensional Vectors with a Theoretical Error Bound for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search)

workload.corpus_scale: 1,000,000,000 (1 Billion) 1024-dim Embeddings (Enterprise RAG chunks, ColQwen2 visual patches & code symbols)
workload.raw_data_footprint: 2,048 GB in FP16 (4,096 GB in FP32) + ~600 GB HNSW M=32 graph edges = 2,650 GB total DRAM if kept in memory
workload.key_mechanisms: DiskANN 4KB sector co-location (vector + neighbors in 1 SSD read), RaBitQ training-free 1-bit bounds, NVIDIA cuVS CAGRA

tiers.name: Tier 1: 全内存未压缩 HNSW 集群 (2,650 GB 纯 DRAM 内存怪兽 · 月烧 $38,400 · 建索引耗时 18.5 小时)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: In-Memory Uncompressed HNSW Cluster (2,650 GB DRAM · $38,400/mo · 18.5h Build)
tiers.index_and_storage_layout: All 1B FP16 vectors (2,048 GB) + HNSW multi-layer graph (602 GB) pinned in server DRAM across 11x 256GB nodes
tiers.search_and_build_path: Pointer-chasing across DRAM graph layers; CPU-bound sequential graph insertion takes 18.5 hours per rebuild
tiers.recommended_for: Small collections (<20M vectors) only; at 1B scale, DRAM cost ($460k/yr) and 18.5h rebuilds are prohibitive.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 纯内存 IVF-PQ 强有损乘积量化 (64B 码本无重排 · 虽省内存但 Recall@10 暴跌至 68.4%)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Aggressive In-Memory IVF-PQ 64B Without Rerank (Recall@10 Collapses to 68.4%)
tiers.index_and_storage_layout: Compresses 2,048B vector into 64B PQ codes (32x compression -> 88 GB RAM); discards full-precision vectors
tiers.search_and_build_path: Scans inverted lists using asymmetric distance computation (ADC) on lossy K-means centroids; suffers severe OOD drift
tiers.recommended_for: Coarse deduplication only; -28.1pt recall loss causes severe RAG hallucination on domain terms and IDs.

tiers.name: Tier 3: NVMe 原生图索引 DiskANN / Vamana (96GB 内存 + 4KB 扇区向量/邻居同块打包 + io_uring 4.2ms)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: NVMe SSD-Resident Vamana / DiskANN (96 GB RAM · 95.2% Recall · 4.2ms P95 · $5,200/mo)
tiers.index_and_storage_layout: 64B PQ guide in DRAM (96 GB) + 4KB NVMe sector packing [Full FP16 Vector + 64 Vamana Neighbor IDs] in 1 SSD page
tiers.search_and_build_path: In-RAM PQ beam navigation + 6-hop parallel io_uring NVMe reads for exact on-the-fly full-precision reranking
tiers.recommended_for: Cost-optimal billion-scale enterprise RAG and document search with <5ms P95 SLA on commodity NVMe nodes.

tiers.name: Tier 4: GPU cuVS CAGRA + 免训练 RaBitQ 1-Bit 无偏量化 + NVMe DiskANN 冷热分层 (96.8% 召回 · 1.4ms)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: GPU cuVS CAGRA + Training-Free RaBitQ + NVMe DiskANN Hybrid (96.8% Recall · 1.4ms · 18.5k QPS)
tiers.index_and_storage_layout: RaBitQ 1-bit/2-bit randomized JL codes (zero codebook drift) + GPU CAGRA fixed-degree graph for hot tier + NVMe DiskANN
tiers.search_and_build_path: GPU warp-parallel CAGRA graph traversal + RaBitQ lower-bound pruning + async NVMe exact top-K verification
tiers.recommended_for: High-QPS billion-scale search, real-time streaming ingestion (zero PQ retraining), and multimodal patch retrieval.
